title: AgentRunIdentity
description: Content-addressed identity for an agentic evaluation run. Additive to benchmarks/REGISTRY.schema.json; does not modify the Program 0 run_id contract. Infrastructure only: this schema authorizes no execution, registers no suite, and asserts no result.

sha256.description: Lowercase sha256 hex. The null digest is rejected so that placeholder pins fail closed.

agent_run_id.description: SHA256 over canonical JSON of the eight component digests.

base_run_id.description: Lineage only. The legacy 4-input run_id, retained so agentic runs can be traced to the Program 0 contract without rewriting historical identities.

components.description: Exactly the eight identity-bearing components. No component is optional: an unpinned component must stop the run rather than silently produce a non-distinguishing identity.

component_sources.description: Optional but strongly recommended: the pre-image of the six components that have structured pins, so that an identity mismatch localizes to a field rather than to an opaque hash. Model and task-spec digests come from the existing Program 0 manifests and have no entry here. NOTE: schema validation does not recompute digests from these pre-images — the relation is a producer obligation, exercised in benchmarks/tests/test_agent_identity.py.

permissions.description: Per-tool permission. Permissions are identity-bearing: the same inventory read-only versus writable is a different system.

image_digest.description: Immutable container digest. A mutable tag is not an identity.

retry_policy.description: Explicit; use 'none' when there are no retries. Unreported retries are a benchmark-integrity failure, so the policy is pinned into identity rather than reported alongside the result.

repeats.description: Independent executions. Required because pass^k is undefined without it.

judge_calibration_sha256.description: Null unless an LLM judge contributes to the score. When non-null, points at a calibration record; see papers/SWE_CAPABILITY_EVALUATION_PROPOSAL.md.
